title: What is the educational level name for the schools with Breakfast Provision
question: What is the educational level name for the schools with Breakfast Provision 2 in county code 37? Indicate the name of the school.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    T1.EILName,
    T1."School Name"
FROM merged_school_data AS T1
WHERE 
    T1."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Breakfast Provision 2'
    AND T1."County Code" = '37'
